brands.name: Mitsven
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped San Diego surfboards by Bob Mitsven — fishes, eggs, midlengths, gliders, and logs in the classic California tradition.

models.name: Mitsven Fish
models.description: Bob Mitsven's Fish is an iconic model hand-shaped in San Diego. Its speed, maneuverability and classic styling make it a must-have board for surfers passionate about authentic riding.

models.name: San Diego Egg
models.description: Bob Mitsven's San Diego Egg embodies the pure tradition of California shaping: Skip Frye-inspired rails, fluid glide and perfect line. A versatile hand-shaped model for surfers seeking speed, control and timeless style.

models.name: Magic
models.description: The Mitsven Magic is a Skip Frye-inspired midlength hand-shaped by Bob Mitsven in San Diego. Fluidity, control and speed: a versatile board designed for pure glide.

models.name: Mitsven Glider
models.description: The Mitsven Glider is a longboard hand-shaped by Bob Mitsven in San Diego. Designed for pure glide and perfect lines, it embodies classic Californian style and timeless surfing tradition.

models.name: Mitsven Log
models.description: The Mitsven Log is a traditional longboard hand-shaped by Bob Mitsven in San Diego. A design inspired by vintage Californian logs, offering stability, elegance and glide for classic style.
